en zebra.explanation: "En zebra" means "a zebra". In Danish the z sounds like an English s, so it is said SEE-bra.

sentence.da: En **zebra** har sorte og hvide striber.
sentence.en: A zebra has black and white stripes.

en zone.explanation: "En zone" means "a zone", an area with its own rules or purpose: en fodgængerzone (a pedestrian zone). Bus and train tickets also work by zones: Billetten gælder to zoner (The ticket covers two zones).

sentence.en: Here is a zone without cars.

en zoologisk have.explanation: "En zoologisk have" means "a zoo". It is the full word, and Danes often shorten it to zoo: Vi skal i zoo (We are going to the zoo).

sentence.da: Vi ser mange dyr i en **zoologisk have**.
sentence.en: We see many animals in a zoo.
